authorization.description: A corporation's VS-operator authorization container, holding one ParticipantAuthorizationRecord per controlled Participant (IDX-DE-QRY-2).

items.description: A per-Participant VS-operator authorization nested inside a VSOperatorAuthorization.

fee_spend_limit.description: Present iff with_feegrant is true: this record's contribution, per vs_operator_fee_period, to the aggregate vs_operator FeeGrant (see listFeeGrants). Not a balance of its own.

expiration.description: End of the current operation-budget cycle; present iff period is set and the cycle has started. Not a validity window end.

period.description: Length of the operation-budget cycle for spend_limit, as a duration (e.g. "86400s"). Never applies to fees.

block_height.description: Resolved indexed height (echoes At-Block-Height when supplied)
